decisionRationale: Owner designs, approvals, frozen design evidence, branch bases, checkpoint order, tests, handoffs, and stop conditions are complete, but explicit activation is blocked by contradictory sequencing authority and local control-plane schema gaps. The merged implementation authorization requires implementation checkpoints and real proof before any activation request, while the proposed activation transaction is what would permit that implementation to begin. The current slice schema also cannot represent required non-goals, handoffs, and activation evidence without an approved local amendment.

blockingFindings.finding: The approved implementation authorization requires owner checkpoints, handoffs, real three-process proof, and cross-runtime evidence before any activation request, while the proposed activation transaction would authorize those implementation branches to begin.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: All five owners must approve a documentation-only replacement or clarification that defines activation as the pre-implementation state transition and keeps completion, lock advancement, and sealing proof-gated.

blockingFindings.finding: schemas/slice.schema.json has additionalProperties false and no explicit nonGoals, requiredHandoffs, or activationEvidence fields, so the requested live Slice 02 record cannot be represented honestly.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Approve and implement a local schema amendment with positive and negative validator tests before the activation commit.

blockingFindings.finding: schemas/handoff.schema.json cannot record immutable artifact digests, branch/design references, dependency checkpoints, hosted CI identity, rollback, owner sign-off, consumer authorization, or domain attachment digests.
blockingFindings.requiredResolution: Approve and implement the local handoff-schema amendment proposed in FATES-SLICE-002-handoff-requirements.md before any completed owner packet is accepted.

remainingActivationConditions: Resolve F002-ACTIVATION-SEQUENCE-001 through explicit owner approval.
Resolve F002-SLICE-SCHEMA-001 and validate the full live Slice 02 draft.
Resolve F002-HANDOFF-SCHEMA-001 before activation authorizes checkpoint production.
nextSafeTask: Prepare and review the documentation-only sequencing clarification and local slice/handoff schema amendments; rerun activation readiness after they merge.
